name: glyph-matrix
title: Glyph Matrix
description: A canvas background tiles small characters in an even grid. Random cells swap glyphs and settle at different opacities on a timer, giving a quiet static-like texture with an optional fade toward the bottom.
use: A developer or tech page wants a quiet code-like texture behind its content.
avoid: You need a calm plain surface; the dense mutating grid can distract and reduce contrast.
a11y: The canvas is aria-hidden and decorative, but the continuous mutation ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-bleed near-black canvas covered edge to edge in a tight, even grid of tiny pale symbols. Their brightness varies slightly, and the bottom third fades into darkness.
behaves: On a short timer a few percent of cells choose a new character and opacity, so the field shimmers without any large movement. It sizes to its container and stops when unmounted.
customise: Set glyphs, cellSize, mutationRate, interval, fadeBottom and color; canvas props such as className and style pass through.
weight: moderate: Canvas redraws thousands of glyphs every 90ms, skipping frames in between.
